sources.title: GitHub - FinleyHolt/FinleyHolt
sources.snippet: WORLDS, an agent that finds an object described in plain language by reasoning over a structured world state built from maps and onboard imagery. State of the art on the CityNav aerial benchmark: 51.8% success over all 5,311 test episodes, 15.7 points above the prior best. Demonstrated on a custom quadcopter.

sources.title: Structured World-State Reasoning for Agentic Robotic Search
sources.snippet: Long-horizon robotic search must resolve natural language against heterogeneous, incomplete, and often ambiguous evidence: textual information, prior maps, and observations arriving over time. The core challenge is to contextualize these streams and decide where to gather evidence before selecting a target. We present WORLDS: World-state Observation and Reasoning for Language-guided Discovery ...
